# SharksZone

SharksZone is a social trading platform where traders share stock ideas, follow each other, and interact through comments and sentiment actions.

## Key pages
- https://sharkszone.com/landing
- https://sharkszone.com/traders
- https://sharkszone.com/pricing
- https://sharkszone.com/how-it-works
- https://sharkszone.com/contact
- https://sharkszone.com/terms
- https://sharkszone.com/privacy
- https://sharkszone.com/disclaimer

## Core features (implemented)
- Social trading posts with symbols, targets, and stop-loss
- Following traders and a traders directory
- Buy/Sell sentiment actions and comments
- Profile analytics (charts, table/calendar views, exports)
- Premium subscriptions (Pro) and premium broker subscriptions
- Telegram notifications and broadcasts

## Notes for crawlers
- The core app experience requires login for personalized feeds.
- Public informational pages are crawlable.
